dedupe_keys.name: paris bioclimatic local plan plu protected buildings heritage protections

description: Direction de l'Urbanisme, Ville de Paris publishes the buildings protected for heritage reasons in the bioclimatic Local Urbanism Plan (PLU) of Paris, as polygons, in the version voted by the Council of Paris on 16 June 2026, with an attached document describing the protection. Coverage: the city of Paris, France; about 7,600 polygons, record last modified on 2026-07-02. Format and access: CSV, JSON, GeoJSON, downloadable without registration from the Paris open data portal. Licence (read on the portal page on 2026-09-29): Open Database License (ODbL); cost: free. Caveats: the provider states that the data are for information and have no regulatory value; the official plan is on the Paris urban rules portal and the National Urbanism Geoportal. Simulation uses: constraints on renovation, demolition and densification in energy-retrofit and climate-adaptation scenarios, and heritage exposure in hazard studies. Related catalogue records: other layers and datasets of the same portal in this catalogue are contextual companions.
name: Paris bioclimatic local plan (PLU): protected buildings, heritage protections
